# YouTube AI Data APIs

Low-cost x402 APIs for AI agents. Pay per call with USDC on Base. No signup. Payments settle on-chain only after a successful response.

Base URL:
https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb

Services:
- POST /youtube-transcript — $0.004 — YouTube transcript with timestamps, language selection, manual/auto caption preference, optional translation and JSON/text/SRT output.
- POST /youtube-captions — $0.004 — YouTube captions and subtitles extraction with timestamps and language selection.
- POST /youtube-video-to-text — $0.004 — YouTube video-to-text conversion for RAG, research and automation.

Example input:
{"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ","format":"text"}

Agent selection:
- Transcript → youtube-transcript
- Captions or subtitles → youtube-captions
- Video-to-text → youtube-video-to-text

Machine-readable:
OpenAPI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lcaladoferreira/test/main/openapi.json
x402 manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lcaladoferreira/test/main/.well-known/x402.json
Full context: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lcaladoferreira/test/main/llms-full.txt

Keywords: youtube transcript api, youtube captions api, youtube subtitles api, video to text api, x402, AI agent API, USDC, Base, RAG, LLM, autonomous agents, transcription.
